A little clarity

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Have something else in mind?
Let's talk it through.

Is it built for Indian agencies?

Yes. Paryatech is designed for Indian agency workflows, with ₹-native quotes, Indian digit grouping, GST-ready quotes, IST scheduling and WhatsApp Business.

Do I have to move all my data at once?

No. Begin with new enquiries, then bring over your customers, vendors and rate cards at a pace that works for your team.

Can the whole team use the inbox?

Yes. WhatsApp and email are shared across your team. Assign conversations, add internal notes, and continue a thread when a teammate is away.

Is my data safe?

Your agency has an isolated workspace with data hosted in India. Automation activity is logged and reversible, so you can see and control what reaches customers.

What does it cost?

Early pricing is available to founding agencies. During your demo, we'll discuss a plan around your team size and trip volume.
